label: Takeaway
detail: Madonna won 43 games and the WHAC Tournament, then reached the NAIA Opening Round final. Going by class, 74% of 2026 plate appearances and 70% of innings can return. Aamir Mitchell's 24 homers very likely cannot: Akron's fall roster lists an Aamir Mitchell at the same position and number. Madonna has not posted a 2027 roster, so every return is unconfirmed.

label: Method
detail: Back means a 2026 Fr., So. or Jr. on Madonna's roster. Out means Mitchell (Akron), Graham Sim (graduated) and listed seniors. A senior can still have eligibility left, so this is a floor to check, not a final count.

label: Season
detail: The 2026 win total is the program's most since 2010 and 15 more than in 2025. Madonna was picked 3rd in the WHAC preseason poll, entered the tournament as the No. 3 seed, and beat Indiana Tech in the final after losing the opener of that series. UNOH won the regular-season title.

label: Opening Round
detail: Lincoln, Neb.: beat Texas Wesleyan 6-1 behind a Jurczyk complete game, lost to Doane 10-9, beat Texas Wesleyan 6-2, lost to Doane 7-4. Doane went on to the World Series.

label: Offense
detail: 8.7 runs per game on .324/.425/.528. Madonna went 22-6 away, 12-5 at home and 9-5 at neutral sites.

label: Steals
detail: 162 steals at 82%, 23rd in the NAIA per game. Spicer stole 22, Stepek 19 and Simon went 16-for-16, and all three can return by class. Etheridge's 29 and Mitchell's 32 are 38% of the total. 30 steals came in the 1st inning and 29 in the 6th.

label: Free passes and strikeouts
detail: The staff allowed 5.2 walks and hit batters per nine, against 7.5 in the WHAC and 6.9 across the NAIA (24th of 179). It struck out 7.43 per nine, which ranks 98th. Gajewski walked 9 in 67 innings and allowed 11 homers and a .280 average.

label: Stepek reaches base by getting hit
detail: Ty Stepek was hit 22 times in 195 at-bats and walked only 12, with 15 strikeouts. He hit .426 with 13 homers in 2025 and .369 with 13 in 2026, but only .312 in WHAC play.

label: Best in league play
detail: Spicer hit .443 with 9 strikeouts in 106 WHAC at-bats. Thompson posted a 1.256 OPS with 30 RBI in 22 WHAC games. Both are back by class.

label: Fielding
detail: Team fielding was .963, 3rd in the WHAC. Noon had 18 errors (.864) and Reed 11 (.947).

label: Late innings
detail: Zilch had 5 saves and 60 strikeouts in 54.1 innings, with a 2.67 WHAC ERA. Kowalski went 5-0 with a 3.79 ERA overall but 6.17 in WHAC play.

label: Catcher
detail: Simon started there in 8 of the last 9 games and 20 overall. Gabel made 28 starts but hit .222 and started only 6 of the last 20 games. Nilson hit .462 in 26 at-bats, and Bridges made 6 starts.

label: First base
detail: Donovan Thompson made 43 starts at first and hit .342 with 10 homers and 53 RBI in 161 at-bats.

label: Middle infield
detail: Luke Spicer made 54 starts at second and was first-team All-WHAC. Brett Reed made 46 starts at short, and Noon has 10 there as a backup.

label: Third base
detail: Carson Noon finished the year there with 29 starts. Davis (19) and Simon (11) also started at third.

label: Outfield
detail: The biggest hole. Mitchell (38 starts in left) and Etheridge (all 59 games in center) are likely gone. Stepek returns in right. Logan Ellis made 22 starts in the corners, and McGowen was the only player to replace Etheridge in center, 6 times.

label: Designated hitter
detail: Kevin Davis made 14 starts at DH and finished the year there. Stepek made 15 and could return to that role if a new outfielder arrives.

label: Rotation
detail: Jurczyk (10-2, 2.95, as a freshman) and Gajewski (6-1, 14 starts) return. Acker (14 starts) and Duley (6) are listed seniors. Sevensma made 10 starts in 2025 and is an option.

label: Bullpen
detail: Zilch, Kowalski, Manoulian and Rowley made 60 relief appearances between them and account for 9 of the 11 saves. Niggemeyer is the main left-hander, with 14 relief outings.

label: Aamir Mitchell, OF
detail: Very likely at Akron. Akron's fall 2026 roster lists an Aamir Mitchell at OF, No. 7, Senior. Madonna had him at OF, No. 7, Junior. Akron lists no previous school and I found no announcement, so this is not official.

label: Graham Sim, RHP
detail: Madonna's staff announcement calls him a 2026 graduate.

label: Incoming transfers
detail: None verified. Madonna has announced none on its baseball news page, and Baseball America's portal tracker does not mention Madonna. 24 of 61 players on the 2026 roster came from JUCOs.

label: Drew Huard, head coach
detail: Second full season produced 43 wins, after 28-24 in 2025. Before Madonna: Oakland assistant and recruiting coordinator; Davenport associate head coach; Lansing CC head coach (81-29, NJCAA DII World Series third place in 2017).

label: Blake McRae, assistant (new)
detail: Hired Aug 2026. Former pro with Mahoning Valley; played at Lansing CC and Eastern Michigan. Director of hitting and strength at 3PD Performance in Waterford; hitting coach at Romeo HS in spring 2026.

label: Brendan Cicalo, assistant (new)
detail: Hired Aug 2026. Three years as Mott CC pitching coach; 15 of his pitchers moved on to four-year schools. Played at Mott and Madonna; 3PD pitching development intern under Max Bain and Adam Bodary.

label: 2026 staff still listed
detail: Dylan Roberts is still at Madonna: his X bio lists him as recruiting coordinator and assistant coach. Madonna's staff page also still lists Ty Hill, Blake Garrison and GA Anthony Sharkas.

label: Aamir Mitchell
detail: First-Team NAIA All-American; WHAC Player of the Year; first-team All-WHAC OF

label: Luke Spicer
detail: First-team All-WHAC 2B

label: Kooper Etheridge
detail: Second-team All-WHAC OF; Gold Glove CF; Champions of Character

label: Ty Stepek
detail: Second-team All-WHAC DH

label: Trey Acker
detail: Second-team All-WHAC SP

label: Program
detail: Eighth WHAC Tournament title, first since 2023

label: Mar 14, game 1: Madonna 5, Cleary 4
detail: Madonna scored 2 in the 6th and 3 in the 7th. Duley started (6.0 IP, 3 ER); Kowalski won; Fay took the loss. Etheridge went 2-for-4 with a triple and 2 RBI; Parinello homered for Cleary.

label: Mar 14, game 2: Cleary 9, Madonna 3
detail: Seman went 8.0 innings for the win and Cleary had 16 hits, 5 runs coming in the 8th. Acker started (5.0 IP); Jurczyk took the loss.

label: May 2, WHAC Tournament: Madonna 8, Cleary 6
detail: Cleary scored 6 over the 7th and 8th; Madonna answered with 5 in the 8th. Gajewski started; VanTubergen won; Manoulian saved it. Stepek homered. Hughes went 4-for-4 and Torresan drove in 3 for Cleary.

label: Madonna recruits around home
detail: 38 of the 51 Michigan players come from Oakland (17), Wayne (15) and Macomb (6) counties. Livonia, where Madonna plays, is the hottest single town with 5.

label: JUCO is the main door
detail: 24 of 61 on the 2026 roster came from a community college and 6 from another four-year school. Those transfers supply most of the lineup: Mitchell, Stepek, Thompson, Etheridge, Simon and Reed all arrived that way.

label: Staff ties line up with feeders
detail: Lansing CC (Huard coached there, McRae played there) has 4 players on the roster. Mott has 2 and its former pitching coach Cicalo is now on staff.

label: 3PD is a new channel
detail: Both new assistants have ties to 3PD Performance in Waterford, which puts Madonna closer to Oakland County arms and bats.

label: Your backyard
detail: Stepek (Walled Lake Northern), Harper (Walled Lake Western), Shaw (Walled Lake Central) and Konja (Walled Lake, Notre Dame Prep) all came from your area.

label: Roster is built to stay close to home
detail: 51 of 61 list a Michigan hometown. Madonna carried a 61-man roster in 2026, so it recruits in volume and many players saw little or no game time.

label: Finds value at Michigan JUCOs you scout
detail: Macomb, Schoolcraft and Henry Ford all sent pitchers or bats here (Stepek, Neufeld, Niggemeyer, Gajewski).

detail: Conference previews plus a Top 25 table with rank, last record and last final rank.
extra: Overview: last season and preseason context up front

label: Baseball America newcomer classes
detail: Each team lists transfers and high school recruits by tier, then explains fit.
extra: Recruiting tab: newcomers by route, with fit notes

label: Black College Nines team previews
detail: Returning starters, starting pitching, relievers and newcomers with prior school, then a short outlook.

detail: A weighted share of last year's production that returns, with transfers added in.
extra: Returning share bars, unweighted for now

detail: Share of minutes from returners. Returner-reliant teams beat expectations far more often than newcomer-reliant ones.

label: No 2027 roster posted
detail: Madonna's roster page still shows 2026, and its 2027 address sends you back to it. The last baseball story on its site is the Aug 7 staff hire.

label: Commits are third-party listings
detail: Prep Baseball Report and Perfect Game list these commitments. Neither confirms enrollment, and Madonna's Recent Signees box showed no names when I loaded it.

label: Senior does not mean gone
detail: Only Sim is confirmed. The other 12 listed seniors, including Etheridge, Acker and Duley, stay unconfirmed until a roster posts.

label: NAIA poll read
detail: Madonna received votes (30 points, unranked) in the 2026 postseason poll, and Indiana Tech was 24th. The 2027 preseason poll wasn't out on Nov 3. Last year's came out Nov 5.

label: League data source
detail: Team comparisons come from the NAIA stats site. Its Madonna ERA is 4.91 (256 earned runs) against Madonna's own 4.93 (257), and its WHIP is 1.41 (474 hits) against Madonna's 1.40 (473), so the comparison table can differ by a hair. WHAC standings weren't readable, but team stats were.

label: 2027 schedule is only partly posted
detail: NAIA stats lists 8 games so far. I found no Cleary date.

label: Pitcher wins are one short
detail: Madonna's individual pitching lines total 42-16 and its conference table 19-8, against a true 43-16 and 20-8. I counted the game log, so the team record stands. Game-level pitcher records in recaps also vary (Zilch shown 16-6, VanTubergen 7-6), so this page uses the season table.

label: Site labels differ
detail: The schedule puts the WHAC Tournament in Grand Rapids and the May 2 box score says Rockford. One Feb 27 game is labeled Livonia, which may explain why counted Livonia games come to 13-5 against the published 12-5 home record.

label: Two unnamed stat lines
detail: Season stats list No. 36 (1 at-bat) and No. 48 (0.1 innings) with no name, and neither number is on the roster. Box scores with those same lines name Sam Stoll and Huetteman, so the game logs use those names. The match rests on the stat lines, since box scores don't show numbers. Their status is shown as Unknown.

label: Spelling corrected
detail: The roster prints Waybonsee and Kellog. I show Waubonsee and Kellogg, and I group Mid-Michigan College and Mid Michigan CC as one school.

label: Checked by arithmetic
detail: All player batting and pitching columns add up to Madonna's published team totals, and the game log adds to 43-16, 513 runs scored and 308 allowed.

label: Indiana Tech on WHAC preseason poll
Maps
detail: Each of the 60 players with a listed hometown is plotted at that hometown. Brett Reed lists none. The hot zone is a density estimate over those towns, so color shows concentration, not exact locations.

label: Starts checked against box scores
detail: I counted starters in all 59 box scores. The totals match Madonna's published games-started figures for every hitter and pitcher, except that season stats give Gillean 1 and Cummins 2 hitter starts, the same as their pitching starts. One Feb 14 box score lists McGowen with no position; I counted him as a substitute, which matches his published 3 starts.

label: Map sources
detail: Hometowns are from Madonna's roster. I entered coordinates by hand and checked 33 of the 47 towns against the GeoNames gazetteer, all within 4 miles. The other 14 had no matching entry. Shapes come from U.S. Census and Natural Earth data.

label: lu_proj
detail: Built from every 2026 box score, using only players listed Fr., So. or Jr. Stepek moves into Mitchell's 2nd spot, Thompson into Stepek's 3rd spot and Davis into Etheridge's 4th spot. Center field and the bottom of the order are the real questions, and a transfer could change both. Stats shown are from 2026.

label: lu_most
detail: A typical 2026 lineup, built from all 59 box scores. Each position goes to the player with the most starts there, using each player once and keeping as many of those starts as possible; the DH spot counts only starts at DH. The order is each player's average spot across all his 2026 starts, lowest first. No one started half the games at DH (Davis, 14), catcher (Gabel, 28) or third (Noon, 29), so those spots were shared. 2027 outlook is the same status used on the rest of this page.

label: lu_all
detail: Madonna used 48 different lineups in 59 games, so even the most-used one was rare. A lineup counts as the same only with the same nine in the same order at the same positions.

label: rot_proj
detail: The same 2026 stats, with my projected 2027 roles. Acker's and Duley's 20 starts are likely gone, so two rotation spots open. Zilch is the best candidate to move up, but if he stays at closer, Kowalski is next in line. A transfer could change this.

label: Lineup counts
detail: Counted from the 59 box scores. When a player is listed at two positions in one game, such as LF/1B, I used the first one.

label: Staff
detail: Main starters made at least 4 starts. Relievers made at least 5 appearances. GS is total starts and Relief is total relief outings, both counted from box scores and matching Madonna's published totals.

label: League
detail: Madonna's offense ranked 18th of 179 NAIA teams by OPS and led the WHAC in slugging and homers. The staff ranked 13th in WHIP but 98th in strikeouts per nine. Cleary was better at avoiding strikeouts (17th vs 70th) and at drawing walks (33rd vs 90th).

label: Method
detail: wOBA uses standard big-league weights, so treat it as a comparison between these teams, not a true college scale. FIP uses a constant that sets the NAIA-wide FIP equal to NAIA ERA. Ranks marked with a lower number are better in every row.

label: Runs by inning
detail: Madonna scored 311 of its 513 runs in innings 3 through 6, including 164 in the 3rd and 4th. It scored 99 from the 7th on, though 7-inning games shorten that count.

label: First inning
detail: Opponents scored 51 runs in the 1st inning, more than in any other inning. Second most was 43 in the 4th.

label: Steals
detail: 120 of 162 steals were of second, 41 of third and 1 of home. 61 of the 162 came in the first three innings.

label: Where Madonna has the edge
detail: Power and depth at the plate: 77 homers to Cleary's 21, and .528 slugging to .453. Madonna also runs more, 162 steals to 75, and has allowed fewer baserunners, with a 1.41 WHIP to 1.58.

label: Where Cleary has the edge
detail: Plate discipline and fielding: a 14.1% strikeout rate to 16.3%, a 13.4% walk rate to 11.5%, and .968 fielding to .963, the best in the WHAC. Cleary's staff also misses more bats, 8.53 strikeouts per nine to 7.43.

label: What the 2026 games showed
detail: Cleary out-hit Madonna 33-24 across the three games, but Madonna won two of them with late scoring: 3 in the 7th on Mar 14 and 5 in the 8th on May 2. Cleary's bullpen allowed most of that damage.

label: Series history
detail: Madonna leads 12-7 since 2019, but the last 10 meetings are split 5-5. Madonna has won 6-4 at home, 5-3 at Cleary and 1-0 on a neutral field.

label: Play-by-play checked
detail: Hits, doubles, triples, homers, walks, hit batters, strikeouts and steals from play-by-play all match Madonna's published team totals, as do opponents' hits, walks, strikeouts and homers. Batters faced matches the NAIA stats figure of 2,129. Plate appearances come to 2,308 against 2,301 published. Four players differ slightly from their published hits (Reed by 2, Serafinchon by 2, Bridges by 1, Collins by 1), so play-by-play credits a few hits differently than the box totals. Pitch-level stats are only as good as each scorer's entries.

label: Filter
detail: All games shows Madonna's published totals. Any other filter is added up from box scores and play-by-play, game by game. The filter changes the Hitters, Pitchers and Tendencies tabs. Player cards always show the full season.

label: Outing log
detail: Days of rest counts full calendar days since the pitcher's previous appearance, whatever the filter. Pitch counts show a dash when a box score lists none.

label: Game-by-game totals checked
detail: Box scores add up to every hitter's published at-bats, hits, walks, strikeouts and RBI. Play-by-play supplies doubles, triples, homers, hit-by-pitches, sacrifice flies and bunts, and those match too. Pitcher lines match. Exceptions: Clark is in 22 box scores with 18 runs and 7 steals, against 16 games, 10 runs and 3 steals in his season line; 8 of those runs are in Cummins' season line. One Carr line sits under Youngquist in season stats. Batters faced differs by 1 or 2 between play-by-play and box scores for Jurczyk, Zilch and Sim.

label: May 2 pitch counts differ
detail: Madonna's and Cleary's box scores of the May 2 game disagree: Gajewski 84 or 83, Zilch 7 or 8, VanTubergen 28 or 24, Manoulian 5 or 9. Both total 131. This page uses Madonna's box.

label: Fake counts in five box scores
detail: Five box scores list nearly every count as 0-0: Feb 7, both Mar 22 games and both Apr 11 games. They are left out of the count and pitch stats, along with the games that list no pitch data.

label: Method
detail: With All games selected, every number in this view counts all 59 games, from box scores and play-by-play. Ground outs include sacrifices and fielder's choices, and air outs include sacrifice flies. That gives Madonna's hitters 435 and 457, against 429 and 458 published as a team, and scorers can classify a few plays differently.

label: Partial
detail: Scorers didn't enter these details for every game, so each number covers only part of the season. Treat them as samples. The first two tables show what's missing.

label: Splits
detail: Innings and time through the order use every plate appearance. Time through the order is each pitcher's batters faced in that game divided by nine, so substitutions can shift it slightly.

label: Splits
detail: Only plate appearances with a count listed. The count is where the plate appearance stood before its final pitch. Two strikes and Full count overlap the other rows.

label: Ground and air outs
detail: Thompson has 2.80 ground outs per air out, the most among regulars (100 or more plate appearances), and Stepek has 0.50.

label: How long arms go
detail: Acker averages 5.1 innings a start, Gajewski 4.8 and Jurczyk 5.7. Zilch 1.9 and Kowalski 1.8 per relief outing.

label: Groundball and fly-ball arms
detail: Zilch has 2.21 ground outs per air out, the most among pitchers with 100 batters faced, and Kowalski has 0.71.

label: First-pitch swings
detail: Davis swings at 46% of first pitches, the most among regulars (100 or more plate appearances), on 81 of 135 plate appearances with pitch data. Thompson swings at 22%, on 151 of 197.

label: Swing and miss
detail: Spicer whiffs on 10% of swings, the fewest among regulars, and Davis on 28%. On the mound, Duley gets a whiff on 26% and Gajewski on 15%.

label: Direction
detail: Simon pulls 59% of his batted balls, the most among regulars, on 148 with a direction. Ellis pulls 23%, on 71.

label: Pitch counts
detail: Jurczyk averages 92 pitches a start and reached 118. Duley averages 66. Averages use only outings with a listed count.

label: Bunts
detail: Scorers marked 35 Madonna bunts, and 22 went for hits. Not every bunt is marked, so the true count may be higher.

label: Checked against NAIA stats
detail: I compared every Madonna game with a gap against NAIA stats, which posts the same box scores as the WHAC site. That added pitch data for both Feb 14 games and pitch counts for Zilch on Mar 10 and Rowley on Apr 19. The other games with gaps have no more pitch data there.

label: Commits on X
detail: On Nov 4 I searched X for commits to Madonna and read the bios of the accounts Madonna and Dylan Roberts follow. I found no 2027 commit to add beyond the Prep Baseball Report and Perfect Game list. X search misses a lot, so this does not show there are none.

label: Spray charts are partial
detail: Spray charts use 1,453 of Madonna's 1,905 at-bats (76%): 95% of balls in play, 89% of hits (547 of 618) and 99% of everything else (906 of 911). Strikeouts have no direction. Scorers skip the direction on hits far more often than on outs, so charts can understate hits. Zones are where the scorer placed the ball, not exact spots. Eight pickoffs at first were being logged as ground outs, and three Feb 14 hits were credited to the wrong hitter in play-by-play. I corrected those from the box scores on Nov 4. Madonna's stats list one hitter as Unlisted #36, and the Feb 14 box score shows that's Sam Stoll.

label: Direction corrected
detail: Double plays were being credited to the relay throw instead of the first fielder, and plays written with the last name first or an error by a fielder had no direction. I corrected that on Nov 4, which moved Pull, Center and Oppo a few points for some hitters and raised the direction counts.
